sloka: यं यं देशं समुद्रस्य जगाम स महाकपिः ।स स तस्योरुवेगेन सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते ॥५-१-६८॥
transliteration: yaṁ yaṁ deśaṁ samudrasya jagāma sa mahākapiḥ ।sa sa tasyoruvegena sonmāda iva lakṣyate ॥5-1-68॥

translations.english: Whichever part of the sea over which that monkey flew, it appeared as though it was riotous with eddies, whirlpools and revolving foam etc., stirred up by the speed of his thighs.
